name: Kingdom of Aksum
notes: Numismatic chronology anchors the early kings (coinage from King Endubis, c. 270-300 CE); Ezana's reign conventionally early-to-mid 320s-c.360 CE. Munro-Hay, Aksum: An African Civilization of Late Antiquity (Edinburgh UP, 1991); Phillipson, Foundations of an African Civilisation (James Currey, 2012).
